say: In Maps, search for a place, tap Directions, and compare travel times. Traffic and flooding change them, so treat times as a guide.

cards.d: Search a place, tap Directions, compare car and walking times. Times are only estimates.
Drop a pin, copy the plus code, add a landmark. Riders find your exact gate.
Copy text from a poster or translate a label. Check medicine and legal results.

say: For example, Comfort bakes cakes from home in a new estate in Abuja, with no street signs. She dropped a pin at her gate and copied its plus code, a short code of letters and numbers.
She saved it with the landmark, blue gate opposite the borehole, as a WhatsApp quick reply. Riders now find her exact gate.

say: Lens copies printed text and translates labels. But translations can be wrong, especially on medicine labels and legal papers. For health, safety or money, ask a pharmacist or a qualified person.

say: A head is a poor place to store dates. Keep is for lists and notes with no fixed time. Share a list, and if your daughter adds tomato paste at home, it appears on your phone at the market.
Calendar is for anything tied to a day: payment days, clinic visits, birthdays. If an event repeats, set it once and it comes back every time.
For example, Aisha's cooperative in Ilorin collects 10,000 naira from each member on the last Saturday of every month. She missed two payment days last year and paid a fine each time.
Step 1. She opens Calendar and taps plus, then Event.
Step 2. She types the title, Cooperative contribution.
Step 3. She chooses the next last Saturday, at 10:00 am when meetings start.
Step 4. She taps Does not repeat, then Custom, monthly, on the last Saturday.
Step 5. She sets two alerts: 2 days before, to make sure the money is ready, and 1 hour before.

panel.heading: Aisha never misses a contribution
panel.rule: Two alerts: one to get the money ready, one final nudge.

say: If alerts never ring, check the app's notifications, and turn off battery optimisation for Calendar.

say: A spreadsheet is a grid of cells. Columns have letters and rows have numbers, so each cell has an address, like B2. In row 1, type Member, then Week 1 to Week 8.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8

say: Put the members' names in A2 to A9.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8

say: Each week, type 5000 for each member who paid, and 0 for anyone who did not. Type 5000, not 5,000 with a naira sign, or the total may ignore it.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8

say: In the Total row, type equals SUM, B2 colon B9 in brackets. The colon means from B2 to B9.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8

say: In the Missed row, type equals COUNTIF, B2 to B9, comma 0. It counts the zeros. Type 0 for a missed payment, never leave it empty.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8

say: Forgetting the equals sign is the most common mistake. Without it, a formula is just text.

panel.heading: Build an ajo record in Sheets
items: Row 1: Member, then Week 1 to Week 8
panel.rule: Every formula starts with an equals sign.

say: For example, Funmi coordinates an ajo of 8 market women in Abeokuta. One member collects the pot each week.
Each pays 5,000 naira, so the weekly pot is 40,000 naira.
In Week 3, the Total showed 35,000 instead of 40,000, and the Missed row showed 1.
At a glance, Funmi knew the collector was 5,000 naira short, and exactly who to follow up with.
Share your sheet with members' Gmail addresses as Viewer, so they can check but not change it. Keep Editor access small.
Never put bank account numbers, BVN, NIN or PINs in a shared sheet or a Keep note. Names and amounts are enough. And add named people instead of Anyone with the link.

panel.heading: Share safely

Keep Editor access for you only

say: To remember. A plus code and a landmark bring riders to your gate. Check Lens results on medicine and money. Keep is for lists and Calendar for dates. SUM totals and COUNTIF counts. And share as Viewer, with no IDs in the sheet.
